shipServerEnabled.label: Enable local TLS/WebSocket SHIP endpoint
shipServerEnabled.help: Starts a local /ship/ endpoint. Full SHIP/SPINE certification still requires device tests.

announceShipService.label: Announce local SHIP service via mDNS
announceShipService.help: Required when wallboxes or other EEBUS devices should discover EOS as local HEMS automatically via _ship._tcp. In EnergyManagementSystem mode this is enforced by the adapter.

serviceName.label: Visible EEBUS/HEMS name
serviceName.help: Name shown by wallboxes during EEBUS/HEMS pairing. The adapter announces this as the local _ship._tcp service instance.

model.label: Model
model.help: Default is EOS so wallboxes show the system as NexoWatt EOS.

deviceCategories.label: SHIP device categories
deviceCategories.help: Comma-separated EEBUS category numbers. 2 = Energy Management System.

ianaPen.label: IANA PEN
ianaPen.help: Used for generated SHIP IDs. Replace the placeholder with the real NexoWatt PEN when available.

certificate.label: Certificate PEM
certificate.help: Leave empty to generate a local certificate on first start.

privateKey.label: Private key PEM
privateKey.help: Protected/encrypted. Leave empty to generate a local private key on first start.

allowCommandsToUntrustedDevices.label: Allow commands to untrusted devices
allowCommandsToUntrustedDevices.help: Default is off. Commands to untrusted or unknown devices are recorded but not sent.

commandDryRun.label: Command dry run
commandDryRun.help: Records draft SPINE command payloads without sending them. Disable only after field validation.

debugRawMessages.label: Store raw diagnostic messages
debugRawMessages.help: May create large states. Enable only for troubleshooting.
